description: The module's DNS record on the TAPPaaS resolver.
_note: update-service.sh execs install-service.sh, which is reconcile-in-place: it creates or updates the record and is safe to re-run. apply:'reconcile' says exactly that.

ip.description: Static IPv4 address of the device this module represents. Used by network:dns to create the DNS host override <vmname>.<zone0>.internal -> <ip>. Must be a static reservation OUTSIDE the zone's DHCP pool; network:dns install-service warns (does not fail) if the IP falls inside a configured pool. No default — supply it in the module JSON (typically under config."network:dns".ip) or override at install time with --ip <addr>.
ip.note: Hardware modules (no VM) declare this so their DNS entry is provisioned automatically at install time (issue #251). The matching static DHCP reservation (MAC-based) remains a manual prerequisite.
ip.changeNote: The address the module's name resolves to. Re-pointing a record is a resolver update; nothing on the guest changes, so no reboot and no downtime. An absent ip means the module resolves from its DHCP lease via masqdns instead, which is the normal case.
